articles.title: Fermented Chickpea Water Research: Early lab results hint at gut benefits; experts stress insufficient human evidence
articles.description: Fermented chickpea water is emerging as a potential ally for gut health, with studies from laboratories suggesting enhanced digestibility and antioxidant properties post-fermentation. This nutritious liquid might provide a brief increase in gut microbial diversity due to its live microbes. However, current human studies do not yet support its effectiveness compared to recognized probiotic foods. Experts advise including a fiber-rich diet and well-established fermented options to promote gut well-being.

articles.title: Brain teaser: Only sharp eyes can spot 1 out of 20 giraffes without a twin in 10 seconds in this safari landscape
articles.description: Optical illusions and brain teasers trick the mind into believing what they see at first, among the many hidden elements present in the image, based on a person’s mindset.And while some brain teasers ask you to solve a puzzle, this one asks you to play matchmaker!Carefully notice the elements as you glance at this brain teaser.Scattered across a bright, sunlit safari scene are 19 cartoon giraffes, and at first glance they look like a chaotic jumble of long necks and spotted patterns.It is only when we look a bit closer that we notice that a pattern emerges, that almost every giraffe has an identical twin somewhere else in the picture.But there is one giraffe in this crowd that is standing completely alone, without any matching partner, no doppelganger hiding in another corner of the frame.Can you take the challenge and find it out?So, here is the image; try to spot the giraffe without any twin!
